taxonomic_history.event: Original description of historically associated name — synonymy pending
taxonomic_history.name: Diapus tonkinensis
taxonomic_history.note: Schedl's original description was verified on pp. 201–202; the asserted relationship with D. quinquespinatus requires separate acceptance.

nomenclature_note: The original species epithet was printed quinque-spinatus and is now written quinquespinatus following mandatory dehyphenation. The original Diapus tonkinensis Schedl, 1972 was directly verified, but a later catalogue's proposed synonymy with D. quinquespinatus remains Pending.
